name: @runecraft/cli
description: Install Runecraft skills for AI coding agents

scripts.build: rm -rf dist catalog && mkdir -p dist && cp -R ../skills/skills catalog && find catalog -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
